articles.title: OU-Texas Is The Last Truly Bonkers College Football Rivalry
articles.author: Israel Daramola
articles.summary: There's no point in trying to predict how a Red River Rivalry game will go. Texas and Oklahoma have aligned themselves to this eternal blood feud, some Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid shit. It doesn't matter what the records next to their names say or what the expectations for each team are, because this game will almost certainly go the opposite of what you expect, and end in a knife fight in the mud. On Saturday, Oklahoma came out of that fight as the last man standing. https://youtu.be/KLxPeYzbp_4?si=FaBU0Ub4x4xoz8OU The Sooners beat the No. 1 ranked Texas Longhorns, 27-24. With the game tied throughout much of the fourth quarter, Arch Manning threw his second interception with about 19 seconds left in regulation. After a couple of incredible passes by John Mateer to get within field goal range, Oklahoma kicker Tate Sandell got the chance for a 47-yard field goal at the end of regulation to put the Sooners over the top.

articles.title: Thousands detained in India in massive anti-government protests
articles.author: Brendan Ruberry
articles.summary: Indian authorities released the leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party on Sunday, after security forces detained thousands of protesters during massive anti-government demonstrations. The satirical party — which in July forced the resignation of India’s education minister — is at the center of youth-led protests that roiled the Indian capital on Saturday, prompted by what the Cockroaches and others allege was a politically motivated purge of voter rolls designed to benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s party. One of the protesters’ chief demands is the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, but “what started as an anti-Gyanesh movement has now become an anti-Modi movement,” a Delhi journalist argued, adding that the prime minister must now choose between “ short-term shows of strength [and] long-term stability .” — Brendan Ruberry

articles.summary: In December 2021, Elon Musk sat for an interview with The Babylon Bee , a conservative satire site.
